title: Owner decision needed: approve bios plan, resume or restart the partial build, second seed?
description:
## Purpose

Get the owner's three decisions before any build resumes or any money is spent on the bios corpus.

## Decisions needed

1. **Approve the plan, scope and size** in the initiative: one seed, 3 x 100-label rounds on dev-100 (+ twins), FINAL = 1,000 test items + 1,000 twins, twin scoring on, guards on, cumulative cap 15,000 Jev requests (about $6-9) plus about 300 gpt-6-luna labeler calls.
2. **Resume or restart the partial build.** An earlier agent started the corpus parametrization and was stopped before finishing. Its changes are UNCOMMITTED in the working tree: new `unified_corpus.py` / `unified_gender.py` (+ specs) and edits to `unified_cli`, `unified_knn`, `unified_labeler`, `unified_lists`, `unified_loop`, `unified_retrieval`, `unified_splits` (+ some specs). Options: (a) resume from it after review and green tests; (b) discard and restart from the last commit. Nobody touches those files until this is decided.
3. **Second seed?** Default: no; only if the owner asks (would roughly double live spend).

## Definition of done

Answers recorded as a comment here; dependent tasks unblocked or rescoped. Cost: $0.

## Links

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md); [UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md)
